name: print-social-blood-donation-posts-cream-blue-red-with-halftone-grid
title: Blood donation pack in cream, blue and red with a halftone grid, boxed headlines and outlined figures
whatItIs: Nine square posts in cream, cobalt blue and coral red with a faint halftone dot grid, bold boxed headlines ('BLOOD DONATION', 'Who Can Donate?', 'Save a Life.'), outlined illustrations of a blood bag, a donor and clasped hands, a large '2021' watermark, and a 'Register and become a donor!' CTA with contact details.
whatItMeans: Trustworthy and organised; the halftone grid and boxed type give a health campaign a retro-poster credibility.
techniques: Split each post into solid colour-block halves.
Use a faint halftone dot grid as texture across a set.
Add a large watermark year for a dated campaign feel.
Keep illustration style to simple outlines for medical clarity.

vocabulary.definition: A pattern of dots that simulates tone or texture.
A large background numeral dating a campaign.
